name: X-Stage Song Studio PC Ready
notes: Verified Windows 10/11 x64 portable ZIP. Native NCN sources with mirrored Song/MID, Lyrics/LYR, Cursor/CUR are supported directly in the head/tail lyrics editor; no LRC or StageWeb catalog required. Strict complete triplet and timing checks; paired LYR/CUR backups, conservative cursor remapping from existing values, safe undo; MIDI stays unchanged. Still supports separate LRC, StageWeb, and editable X-Stage Karaoke replacement presets. Extract ZIP and run Start-Song-Studio.cmd.
